import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import math
import gc


# Haversine distance function
def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    dlat = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = (
        np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(np.radians(lat1)) * np.cos(np.radians(lat2)) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
    return R * c


# Manhattan distance
def manhattan(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return abs(lat2 - lat1) + abs(lon2 - lon1)


# Direction (bearing)
def bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    dlon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    lat1_r = np.radians(lat1)
    lat2_r = np.radians(lat2)
    x = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2_r)
    y = np.cos(lat1_r) * np.sin(lat2_r) - np.sin(lat1_r) * np.cos(lat2_r) * np.cos(dlon)
    return (np.degrees(np.arctan2(x, y)) + 360) % 360


# NYC bounding box center
NYC_CENTER = (40.7128, -74.0060)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", nrows=5500000)  # Sample for efficiency
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Load labels
labels = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
train = train.merge(labels, on="key")

# Clean data - remove outliers
train = train[train["fare_amount"] > 0]
train = train[train["fare_amount"] < 500]
train = train[train["passenger_count"] > 0]
train = train[train["passenger_count"] <= 6]
train = train[
    (train["pickup_latitude"].abs() <= 90) & (train["pickup_longitude"].abs() <= 180)
]
train = train[
    (train["dropoff_latitude"].abs() <= 90) & (train["dropoff_longitude"].abs() <= 180)
]


# Feature engineering
def engineer_features(df, is_train=True):
    df = df.copy()

    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
        df["pickup_datetime"].str.replace(" UTC", "")
    )
    df["pickup_datetime"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.tz_localize("UTC")

    # Time features
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["day_of_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Distance features
    df["haversine_distance"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["direction"] = bearing(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Distance to NYC center
    df["pickup_distance_to_center"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], NYC_CENTER[0], NYC_CENTER[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_distance_to_center"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], NYC_CENTER[0], NYC_CENTER[1]
    )

    # Additional distance features
    df["distance_ratio"] = df["manhattan_distance"] / (df["haversine_distance"] + 1e-5)
    df["abs_diff_lat"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"])
    df["abs_diff_lon"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"])

    # Airport features (approximate JFK/LGA coordinates)
    JFK_COORDS = (40.6413, -73.7781)
    LGA_COORDS = (40.7769, -73.8740)

    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], JFK_COORDS[0], JFK_COORDS[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], JFK_COORDS[0], JFK_COORDS[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], LGA_COORDS[0], LGA_COORDS[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], LGA_COORDS[0], LGA_COORDS[1]
    )

    return df


print("Engineering features...")
train = engineer_features(train)
test = engineer_features(test, is_train=False)

# Features to use
feature_cols = [
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "day_of_month",
    "month",
    "year",
    "is_weekend",
    "haversine_distance",
    "manhattan_distance",
    "direction",
    "pickup_distance_to_center",
    "dropoff_distance_to_center",
    "distance_ratio",
    "abs_diff_lat",
    "abs_diff_lon",
    "pickup_to_jfk",
    "dropoff_to_jfk",
    "pickup_to_lga",
    "dropoff_to_lga",
]

# Split for validation
X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["fare_amount"].values
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

# Create LGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_cols)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, feature_name=feature_cols, reference=train_data
)

# Train model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    num_boost_round=1000,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validate
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.6f}")

# Train on full training data for submission
print("Training final model on full data...")
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb.Dataset(X, label=y, feature_name=feature_cols),
    num_boost_round=model.best_iteration,
)

# Predict on test set
X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test["key"], "fare_amount": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
